lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity green circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid-like formation; local maxima are concentrated in the mid-flank with distinct spatial separation between clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated green luminance intersecting with high-intensity blobs to create a visible coordinate-based lattice across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Parallel horizontal linear features along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-luminance peaks to low-luminance shadows.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast green bioluminescent-like effect where high-pixel-intensity patterns are isolated against a near-zero luminance background.
